sentence: Never offer Nathan to a Clavito expecting small bones.

wombos.definition: A bilingual intensifier meaning absolutely nothing — a blend of the Spanish nada and the English nothing used for emphatic negation.
wombos.example: I have Nathan to wear to this party.

wombos.definition: A powerful, authoritative figure whose dominance is rooted in elite clavicular mogging — a Godfather-type who rules through bone structure as much as presence.
wombos.example: You don't challenge a Clavito — his collarbones alone end careers.
